Notion is a connected all-in-one workspace company based in San Francisco, with offices around the world. It combines documents, wikis, projects, and databases into a single product, featuring Notion AI and custom agents to automate repetitive tasks. The platform aims to streamline workflows by consolidating various tools into one flexible environment.
